context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 経ち/冷房/断然/少量/丸く/傾い/羽目/延ばし

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、入学から、もう一年経ち、頼もしくなったな。
lines.en: Sakura — it's already been a year since you started. You've become so dependable.
lines.style: Warm reflection, almost to himself. Quiet admiration. Speaks slowly, like he's noticing it as he says it. Not looking away.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。教室の冷房、効きすぎて、苦手です。
lines.en: Thank you. The air conditioning in class is too strong — it's been bothering me.
lines.style: Earnest and direct, with a slight apologetic undertone for bringing up a minor complaint. Matter-of-fact delivery, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学食、断然、ラーメンが美味しい。
lines.en: The cafeteria ramen is definitely the best thing they serve.
lines.style: Casual observation, almost thinking out loud. Light tone, no weight behind it. Building connection through shared small talk.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お米、少量で抑えて、ダイエット中です。
lines.en: I've been keeping my rice portions small — I'm trying to watch what I eat.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware humor underneath. Not defensive, just matter-of-fact about her own choices. Slight wry smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 丸く編んだ髪、似合うな。
lines.en: That braided hairstyle really suits you.
lines.style: Genuine, unguarded compliment. Soft voice. He means it and isn't trying to hide that he noticed. Brief pause before speaking, like he's deciding whether to say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夜、ベンチに座ったら、傾いていて、笑いました。
lines.en: Last night I sat on that bench outside, and it was tilted — I couldn't help but laugh.
lines.style: Light and animated, recounting a small funny moment. Her voice lifts slightly on 'tilted.' Genuine laugh underneath the telling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強、徹夜する羽目になるなよ。
lines.en: Make sure you don't end up pulling an all-nighter to study, okay?
lines.style: Gentle concern masked as casual advice. Quiet but firm. Not lecturing — more of an older friend's soft caution. Eye contact quality steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。試験、延ばしてもらえそうにありません。
lines.en: Yeah, I don't think I'll be able to get the exam postponed.
lines.style: Subdued acceptance. Slightly resigned tone, but not hopeless. Speaking more quietly than before, the conversation settling into a quieter register.
